case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 1700/2023 [ARISING OUT OF SLP(C) NO. 29890/2018]

parties.respondent: Summit Online Trade Solutions (P) Ltd & ORS.

summary: Territorial jurisdiction under Article 226(2); cause of action requirement for writ petitions; notification under Goa GST Act challenged; High Court of Sikkim found lack of jurisdiction; cause of action not pleaded to arise within Sikkim; appellant State of Goa successfully argued challenge to state notifications can only be filed in High Court of Bombay at Goa; jurisdictional error corrected; deletion of State from writ respondents ordered.
legal_provisions_cited: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
Goa Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court of Sikkim judgment set aside; writ petitions cannot proceed against State of Goa in that court; State of Goa ordered to be deleted from respondent array.
